review_conclusions: Public admission is owner-held and performs no originating widget reads; actual field state/commit executes at its existing originating FIFO with render lock and owner.
Epoch is nonzero-sized, captured for each ordinary queued Change; settlement retires prior queued snapshots without coalescing ordinary delivery.

The committed controlled Change runs before settlement callback, with last-delivered state recorded first; callback-driven close/retirement is checked before continuing and no native widget read follows application code.
Shared per-window capacity, cancellation, late remount and lifetime contracts remain those of existing text settlement transport.
